mechanism: cross-sectional illiquidity premium: coins with high trailing bar-level price impact (|return|/dollar volume) earn higher subsequent returns; patient capacity providers are compensated by immediacy-demanding flow

claim_to_test_mapping.claim: ILLIQ = mean(|r|/dollar volume) is positively priced cross-sectionally
claim_to_test_mapping.repo_test: sign of the weekly high-minus-low ILLIQ book net spread on the frozen snapshot

claim_to_test_mapping.claim: low-frequency liquidity proxies capture actual high-frequency crypto liquidity
claim_to_test_mapping.repo_test: rank-persistence stability of the bar-computed characteristic across formation dates

claim_to_test_mapping.claim: crypto returns relate cross-sectionally to liquidity dynamics
claim_to_test_mapping.repo_test: anchor sign consistency (prior only; never a gate waiver)

claim_to_test_mapping.claim: equity Amihud spread partly explained by short-horizon reversal component (confound)
claim_to_test_mapping.repo_test: predeclared reversal-orthogonality diagnostic; family REJECTED if spread is fully absorbed by lagged 1d/7d reversal exposure

feature_contract.illiq_feature: sum |15m log return| / sum dollar volume over trailing 28d; winsorised 1%/99% cross-sectionally
feature_contract.neighbour_feature: Roll (1984) implied effective spread from negative first-order serial covariance of 15m price changes, trailing 28d
feature_contract.residualisation: NONE for sorting (liquidity-level sort); BTC-beta leg neutralisation only, 90d rolling daily beta convention
feature_contract.pit_lag: features from completed bars strictly before decision instant; one declared execution lag; fills strictly after decision instant

universe_and_benchmark.universe: staged USD-M perps with >=60d history and median daily dollar volume above staged-universe cross-sectional median (PIT tradability floor)
universe_and_benchmark.benchmark_role: BTC perp = beta anchor and A7-N orthogonality reference, context-only, never a scored long position; scored object is the dollar-neutral long-minus-short spread

schedule.turnover_control: quintile buckets with entry/exit buffer bands; expected one-way turnover ~0.30 of book per decision; equal-weight buckets with per-symbol weight cap 1/(2*N_bucket)
schedule.floor_precheck: 52<=60 decisions; min completed span 7d so median >=3d; full-swap worst case ~6.2%/yr base drag < 8% base and < 12% stressed floors; turnover share cap via weight cap and buffer spread

anchor.name: ILLIQ-AMIHUD-28D-W
anchor.book: long high-ILLIQ / short low-ILLIQ equal-weight bucket book, 28d formation, weekly hold

neighbour.name: ILLIQ-ROLLSPREAD-28D-W
neighbour.book: same mechanism, Roll implied-spread illiquidity estimator, 28d / weekly hold
neighbour.justification: independent microstructure estimator of the SAME immediacy-provision mechanism; sign inconsistency across estimators = estimator noise, reject

causal_negative_control.name: ILLIQ-AMIHUD-28D-W-INV
causal_negative_control.falsification: any positive after-cost spread on the inverted book destroys the mechanism claim

expected_sign: anchor net spread > 0 after native funding and adapter costs; neighbour same sign; inverted control <= 0
falsification_conditions: inverted control earns positive after-cost spread
A3 schedule-only cost gate FAIL or UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED
spread concentrated in one fold or one symbol (Stage-A concentration gates)
reversal-orthogonality diagnostic absorbs the spread (Lou-Shu artifact) -> reject as reversal in disguise
anchor positive while Roll-spread neighbour negative -> estimator-inconsistent, reject
funding_cost_treatment: native funding accrued LONG_PAYS_POSITIVE_RATE while held, pass-through only, never a signal or filter; costs via adapter rebalance_cost_between at baseline and fee x1.5 / +2-tick stressed cells; fail-closed on missing prices

ancestry_orthogonality.v10_m01: no shared mechanism, signal object (bar |r|/volume vs aggressor trade prints), or cadence (weekly vs intraday); M01 died on turnover/costs which this family must clear first at A3
ancestry_orthogonality.banned_families: not trend/momentum (no past-return signal); not reversal (liquidity-level sort, reversal diagnostic predeclared, disguised reversal = REJECT); not volume-shock continuation (volume is a level denominator, no shock event); not weekly reversal; not funding carry (funding pass-through only); not crowding rescue (see is_rescue fields)
ancestry_orthogonality.reserved_seeds: seeds sort on residual-vol / residual MAX-SKEW (return-distribution moments); this family sorts on a microstructure liquidity characteristic; expected correlation handled by predeclared A7-N rank-orthogonality rho vs both seeds with residual-vol and MAX ranks as diagnostic controls

data_readiness.required_fields: 15m completed bars with volume, BTC bars, funding settlements, mark price (all in frozen staged snapshot); OI not required; no new external data
data_readiness.coverage_risk: volume field gaps on older symbols -> fail-closed UNAVAILABLE, never synthesized
data_readiness.implementation_estimate_days: 1.5-2.0 (GenericStrategyBase plugin + ILLIQ/Roll feature module + PIT no-leak fixtures)

is_rescue_reasoning: no rejected family in the provided lessons used an Amihud/Roll-type characteristic; M01 (aggressor-flow absorption) shares only the word 'liquidity' and none of its mechanism, signal object, or cadence; the A3 cost gate that killed M01 is the first gate this family must pass; banned/reserved lists are return-shape or flow-shape families and both disguised-identity paths (reversal artifact, low-vol/MAX proxy) have predeclared rejection diagnostics
